description: Linux kernel module source code for APU2 LED/GPIO driver supporting GPIO and LED control on PC-Engines APU-2 board, including platform driver registration, GPIO handling, and device registration.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_get_dir
methods.description: Reads GPIO direction (input/output) for a given GPIO offset.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_dir_in
methods.description: Sets GPIO direction to input for a given GPIO offset.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_dir_out
methods.description: Sets GPIO direction to output for a given GPIO offset.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_get_data
methods.description: Reads GPIO data (value) for a given GPIO offset.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_set_data
methods.description: Sets GPIO data (value) for a given GPIO offset.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_probe
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO driver, maps hardware resources, and registers GPIO chip.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_remove
methods.description: Cleans up GPIO chip on driver removal.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_init
methods.description: Module initialization: registers platform driver, creates platform devices, and registers LEDs and keys.

methods.name: gpio_apu2_exit
methods.description: Module cleanup: unregisters devices and driver.
